'''Robet Makina''' was a one-time supporter of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] who joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] after witnessing the viciousness of the Empire. He was loyal to the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] and eventually became the New Republic [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassador]] to [[Glova]].

==Behind the scenes==
In the reprint of [[The Politics of Contraband (adventure)|''The Politics of Contraband'']] in ''[[Classic Adventures]]'', Makina's name is given as "Robert Makina" in his biography, but is kept as "Robet" in the text of the adventure. ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', published in [[2008]], lists him as "Robet Makina." This article assumes that ''Classic Adventures'' biography text was in error.
